name: What is a backyard tiny home?

mainEntity.name: What is a backyard tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A backyard tiny home, also known as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or granny flat, is a secondary housing unit on a property with an existing single-family home. These homes are typically smaller than the main residence and serve various purposes, such as housing family members, generating rental income, or providing a dedicated workspace. Zen Tiny Homes specializes in designing and constructing custom backyard tiny homes tailored to your specific needs and property layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: A backyard tiny home is a secondary housing unit, also known as an ADU, built on a property with an existing single-family home.
